facts.text: Chartered on December 23, 1836 as the Georgia Female College, Wesleyan College was the first college in the world chartered specifically to grant degrees to women.

sources.title: Wesleyan College History
sources.quote: Chartered as the Georgia Female College on December 23, 1836, Wesleyan was founded through the efforts of a group of Macon citizens and the Georgia Conference of the Methodist Episcopal Church as evidence of their concern for the education of women.
